# Re-test comparison: Toolshop (sprint 5 with deliberate bugs)

Prepared by Harbour Lane Digital for Practice Software Testing (Testsmith) · 17 October 2026 compared with 15 October 2026 · Runs run_20261014-231000_s4mp1e and run_20261016-232000_s4mp2e

## Summary

**1 new, 1 fixed, and 6 still open, against WCAG 2.2 AA in tested pages. 1 journey that worked last time no longer works.**

## Journeys that stopped working

- **Checkout:** worked last time, did not work this time. Did not work for the test account: at step 26 of 26, the page should have said "Thanks for your order!" but said "Payment was successful" instead, after the site's server answered 500 (an error on its side) to POST /invoices.

## Journeys that work again

None.

## New issues

- J-01 · High · Checkout did not work (`journey:checkout`)

## Fixed since last time

- Lists are built incorrectly (was Medium, `a11y:list`)

## Still open

- A-01 · Medium · Images have no description: 19 places last time, 19 now (`a11y:image-alt`)
- A-02 · Medium · Text is too faint to read easily: 15 places last time, 15 now (`a11y:color-contrast`)
- A-03 · Medium · Buttons have no name: 4 places last time, 4 now (`a11y:button-name`)
- A-04 · Medium · Form fields have no label: 3 places last time, 3 now (`a11y:label`)
- A-05 · Medium · Buttons or links are too small to tap: 2 places last time, 2 now (`a11y:target-size`)
- A-06 · Medium · Dropdowns have no label: 1 place last time, 1 now (`a11y:select-name`)

## Scope and limits

- This comparison lists issues found against WCAG 2.2 AA in tested pages, in both runs. It covers only the pages and journeys in those runs.
- "Fixed" means the automated checks no longer find the issue on pages that were checked again. Criteria that need a person still need one.
- This is not a security test. Nothing was done to look for vulnerabilities, and the results say nothing about how secure the site is.
- Testing was done under the site's published permission for test practice (https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/), record toolshop-live-practice.
- The full report for this run is `client-report.md` in `run_20261016-232000_s4mp2e`.
